candidate: H61 derivative-free three-bank hard product-code value atlas plus affine tangent jet

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H60's affine jet alone improves heldout output and JVP, but its smooth nonlinear value carrier spends the JVP gain. Replace that carrier with a parent-output-routed piecewise-constant product code whose exact local routing JVP is zero while retaining the affine jet.

scientific_question: Can a derivative-free hard value atlas improve heldout teacher outputs without consuming the transferable affine jet's first-order gain under the same compact budget?

frozen_teacher.procedural_parent_policy: Use exact step-zero MLP tensors in the audit; exclude them from the compact artifact and require independent config-seed regeneration identity before any later model training.

frozen_function_inventory.activation_anchor: exact per-layer mean of the frozen training input inventory, charged and stored as FP16

frozen_representation.formula: y0_l=f0_l(x); k_lm=argmax((y0_l Rm^T)+b_lm); v_l=sum_m g_lmk C_mk; yhat_l=y0_l+v_l+o_l+(((x-mu_l)Vj)*q_l)Uj^T
frozen_representation.routing_forward: hard argmax independently in each of three banks
frozen_representation.routing_jvp_for_fit_and_gate: exact hard-function local derivative: zero away from cell boundaries

initialization.initial_function: exact step-zero procedural MLP because codebook, tangent write, and output offsets are zero

fit.objective: mean relative output MSE plus 0.25 times relative exact hard-function input-JVP MSE
fit.optimizer: AdamW on compact coordinates except frozen charged activation anchors
fit.layer_schedule: deterministic round-robin over all twelve layers

controls.step_zero_parent: zero codebook, tangent U, and output offsets
controls.hard_value_only: zero tangent U and output offsets; exact JVP must equal the parent JVP
controls.global_code_coordinates: replace layer-private router biases and code gains by their across-layer means
controls.initial_random_router: replace fitted router by its exact deterministic initialization
controls.single_bank_only: retain only bank zero's selected code contribution
controls.dense_teacher: exact terminal teacher output and input-JVP identity

runtime_gates.watchdog_policy: terminal/error callbacks plus one resettable 90-minute heartbeat for any run observed or projected above five minutes

promotion: Only an every-layer representation pass and exact hard-value JVP identity authorize exact-config latency and MFU measurement. Only representation plus performance may authorize one 124M CE acquisition. A pass does not authorize scale-up or attention work.
failure: Close this exact three-bank hard product-code value atlas without bank, code-count, temperature, tangent-rank, seed, optimizer, horizon, CE, attention, or scale sweeps.
forbidden: stored PCA or empirical trajectory basis
persistent FP16 or FP32 dense endpoint master
using the straight-through soft derivative as the reported or gated JVP
changing bank count, code count, temperature, initialization, optimizer, objective or gates after seeing results
CE, attention work or scale-up before representation and performance gates pass
calling regenerated step-zero endpoints compact checkpoint state
